_comment: Reference Claude Code hooks configuration for the SAD methodology. Place at ~/.claude/settings.json (global) or <repo>/.claude/settings.json (project). Customize the helper script paths to match your environment. See hook-intentions-2026-05-14.md for the design intent each hook implements.

SessionStart._comment: Methodology session-start ritual: time-awareness + session-capture + read context. Per SAD v3 PART 3 + PART 4 session-start ritual + the time-awareness/session-capture skills.

hooks.command: echo 'session-start' > /dev/null && date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' && echo 'Methodology session-start ritual: declare scope level (Global / Project / Local), read most-recent SESSION_LOG entry, read relevant CLAUDE.md.'

SessionEnd._comment: Methodology session-end ritual: time-awareness + session-capture + draft SESSION_LOG entry. Per SAD v3 PART 3 session-end ritual.

hooks.command: date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' && echo 'Methodology session-end ritual: write _sessions/raw/<date>-<slug>.md if substantive; append compiled entry to _sessions/SESSION_LOG.md; update enumeration row statuses; update per-project orchestration HTML.'

PreToolUse._comment: Pre-commit ritual: when about to run git commit, surface every staged file, check lockfile pairing, check brand-load-bearing files. Per build-roadmap §13, §14, §16.

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git commit'; then echo 'PRE-COMMIT RITUAL: Run git diff --stat HEAD; surface every file with its session-of-origin; confirm brand-load-bearing files explicitly; verify lockfile is staged if package.json is staged.'; fi

PreToolUse._comment: Pre-deploy ritual: when about to run deploy commands, check articulation closure verification. Per build-roadmap §17 + the v3.0.1 phase-closure-protocol amendment.

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(wrangler deploy|vercel --prod|gh workflow run.*deploy|pnpm deploy|npm run deploy)'; then echo 'PRE-DEPLOY GATE: Verify articulation closure inventory is green. Verify brand-load-bearing assets are present in code. Verify lockfile in sync with package.json. Block deploy if any verification row is missing or partial.'; fi

PostToolUse._comment: Post-tool-use stamp: when a Write or Edit modifies a compiled artifact (spec, entity profile, methodology doc), surface the option to update last-reviewed timestamp.

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(spec/|entity-profile.md|methodology/.*\.md|venture-template/.*\.md|skills/.*/SKILL\.md)'; then echo 'POST-EDIT REMINDER: This edit touched a compiled artifact. Consider updating last-reviewed timestamp + bumping version/checksum if applicable.'; fi

UserPromptSubmit._comment: Recognize methodology lifecycle signals in user prompts: wrap up / commit / deploy / start session.

hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT" | grep -qiE '(wrap up|end session|save progress|let.?s deploy|let.?s ship|ready to commit|let.?s commit)' && echo 'LIFECYCLE SIGNAL detected. Consider invoking the appropriate session-end / pre-commit / pre-deploy ritual.'

_note_on_implementation: These reference hooks use inline shell commands for portability. For substantial methodology workflows, the inline commands should call out to helper scripts at everything-ecosystem/methodology/scripts/ (TO-AUTHOR). The scripts would implement the full ritual rather than just printing a reminder. The current state: reminders surface the ritual; the AI (and operator) execute it. Future state: scripts execute it automatically.

_environment_compatibility.claude-code: Native support. This config goes at ~/.claude/settings.json or <repo>/.claude/settings.json.
_environment_compatibility.cowork: Hooks not native. Methodology compensates via skill behavior — skills detect lifecycle signals and run rituals proactively. See hook-intentions-2026-05-14.md.
_environment_compatibility.api-direct: Hooks not available. Methodology compensates via system prompt guidance + skill loading.
